title: Rosenfeld Library, architect's Plan Level 1 (UCLA floor 1, uncertain)

source.publisher: Pei Cobb Freed & Partners (architects of the Anderson complex, 1995)
source.license: Copyright Pei Cobb Freed & Partners; portfolio images with no stated license, used as reference for tracing only
source.what: Pei Cobb Freed & Partners, UCLA Anderson School of Management, Plan Level 1 (whole complex; building E is the library)

how: Walls are the dark lines of the plan image; rooms are the spaces they enclose, with door gaps closed by extending each wall end up to 2 m. The plan has no scale or north arrow, so its building outline was fitted to the mapped outline (scale, rotation and shift, by iterative closest point).
notes: The plan is the architects' presentation drawing of the whole Anderson complex; only building E (Rosenfeld Library, the trapezoid at the north end of the complex) is traced, cropped to that block and fitted to the mapped outline by ICP.

Floor numbering is reconciled with UCLA's as: architect's Level 1 = UCLA 1, Ground Floor = UCLA 2, Level 2 = UCLA 3, Level 3 = UCLA 4. Reasoning: the Level 1 sheet shows the parking deck under the Marion Anderson Courtyard, so Level 1 is below the Ground Floor; the Anderson complex map (2018) calls the courtyard the 2nd level, Wells Fargo Court (the plaza south of the library, drawn paved on the Level 2 sheet) the 3rd level, and the Structure 5 entrance level 1; the library has four UCLA floors (1 to 4). This is a reading of the drawings, not a statement from the architects, so the UCLA floor is uncertain and the architect's level name is kept in the title.

No room numbers, scale or north arrow on the drawing: rooms are unlabeled; walls, stairs, the elevator core and the stacks/reading areas are what the trace gives. Furniture (stacks, tables, chairs) is drawn with thin lines and is removed with open_px; thick walls stay.

Orientation: the block's slanted west side and the notch on its south side match the mapped outline only one way round, and the complex map confirms the library at the north end with Cornell Hall (D) to its south-east; the drawing is taken north-up (rot_init 0) and the ICP refines it.

On the Level 1 sheet the library block continues south into the rooms under Wells Fargo Court and the parking deck; the crop stops at the outline's south edge and anything outside the outline is dropped.

The stack floor's outer walls are drawn as dashed window walls; cuts along them (west, north and east) keep the room from leaking into the terraces outside, and one cut closes the doorway in its south wall to the lobby below Wells Fargo Court (the lobby runs off the cropped sheet).

fit.transform: similarity, plan footprint fitted to the building outline (ICP)
